scope: One isolated top-to-bottom run of the recovered final orchard sensitivity method; no extra model selection or changed fitting criteria.

entry_only_fixes: Canonical output path protection, including nonexistent-parent and symlink paths.

516.explanation: The new search selected a finite-shape OU full fit with higher likelihood than the frozen analytical-boundary selection. The null likelihood and analytical-boundary likelihood are nearly unchanged. This moves the statistic across the observed threshold, outside the ambiguity band; it is not a tail-count arithmetic or rounding change.

911.explanation: The frozen run retained this index as failed because a higher full-model likelihood had not passed the quality gates. The new RI fit reaches approximately that previously recorded higher likelihood and passes the unchanged convergence, Hessian, gradient and cap checks. It can therefore enter the tail as an exceedance under the recorded rules.

bounded_cause_review.cause_status: Numerical search and quality-gate paths differ. Their individual contributions cannot be uniquely separated from small changes in simulated responses.
known_differences: The rerun uses the final active rules from the beginning rather than recovering the original interactive fit cache.
Hardware, operating system and BLAS/LAPACK differ despite matching R and package versions.
bounded_cause_review.interpretation: The changes are compatible with numerical fit-path differences; the bounded review did not identify a source bug. The evidence does not establish that optimization history alone caused every difference, and it does not demonstrate a global optimum for every fitted likelihood.

release_handling.required_disclosure_in_reproducibility_n: The isolated method rerun completed but did not exactly reproduce the frozen per-index bootstrap classifications or numerical p-value bounds. Both ranges exceed 0.05. This agreement does not validate the covariance model or remove the exploratory limitations.

saved_new_simulation_evidence.data_kind: Simulated responses from the new method reproduction, not field measurements and not recovered original random datasets.
saved_new_simulation_evidence.RDS_payload: Plain numeric 24 by 999 matrix; no fit objects, environments or private file paths.
saved_new_simulation_evidence.column_order: Columns 1 through 999 correspond to classification indices 1 through 999; CSV headers simulation_0001 through simulation_0999.
saved_new_simulation_evidence.row_order: Rows 1 through 24 correspond to observation_index in observation_order_and_inputs.csv.
